title: Representation Attached to a Covering Datum
body_html:
Representation Attached to a Covering Datum

For a covering datum \(\widetilde\Sigma=(x,\Gamma,\phi,\rho,\xi)\), let \[ \widetilde\xi:K\times\mathbb C^\times\to\widetilde K \] be the isomorphism induced by the splitting \(\xi\). The genuine \(K\)-type is \[ \widetilde\eta_{\widetilde\Sigma} =(\eta_\Sigma\boxtimes\operatorname{id}_{\mathbb C^\times})\circ\widetilde\xi^{-1}, \] and the attached genuine representation is \[ \widetilde\pi_{\widetilde\Sigma} =\operatorname{c-Ind}_{\widetilde K}^{\widetilde G} \widetilde\eta_{\widetilde\Sigma}. \]

The paper calls \(\widetilde\pi_{\widetilde\Sigma}\) the supercuspidal representation attached to \(\widetilde\Sigma\).
